calendar.usage: Event ledger and Notes use calendar matches, manual upcoming appointments, and fallback event history.

auth_and_permissions.global_permission_model: All allowlisted users are currently normalized to super_admin with artist, counter, and admin roles.
auth_and_permissions.admin_tools_visibility: Admin and Pricing tabs are visible when canAccessAdminToolsForViewer is true.

retired_systems.view_as: Retired and old viewer override storage is cleared on auth provider load.
retired_systems.admin_promotion: Removed from active Admin UI; do not rebuild without explicit approval.

auth_and_permissions.payout_dropdown_rule: Only full payout access emails can see the full person picker. Other users see only their own payout schedule plus explicit delegated people.
auth_and_permissions.admin_payout_ledger_rule: Admin Tools shows Open Payout Ledger only for full payout access emails.

visible_bottom_tabs.pay: Visible to bypass/admin/super_admin and artist/counter-role viewers.

event_card_buttons.client: Opens Client Details in edit mode. This is the first client-card action and uses the shared contact-style icon.

event_ledger.cancelled_visibility: Cancelled/canceled and Not Likely to Continue rows are hidden from the event ledger cards.
sort_order: Open/non-complete cards sort by Sheet event date/start time, soonest first.
Undated cards sort last by client name.
event_ledger.card_money_visibility: Computed Total and Balance are not shown on the event ledger client card face.
event_ledger.post_deposit_additions: When status is deposit paid or later and a numeric deposit exists, Added After Deposit Paid is max(0, computed total - deposit/0.30).
event_ledger.appointment_footer: Shows Next Appt and Last Appt. Manual upcoming appointment from Notes overrides calendar next appointment on the card face; calendar next/last are fallback/display sources.
event_ledger.google_calendar_button: Built as all-day event from event date, client/type title, venue/address, phone, and email.
event_ledger.map_button: Shown when venue/address is not TBD and has a usable query.
event_ledger.latest_communication_preview: Shows most recent staff activity entry for visible event IDs.

artist_picker.alias_normalization: Artist aliases such as Lady Shy, Tomma Mueller, Baby J, Meg, etc. are normalized to canonical names.

staff_assignment.save_rule: Saving staff assignment upserts the event to the sheet, then refreshes by Entry ID when possible.

edit_mode.default: Read-only unless opened with edit=1 or pencil is toggled.
edit_mode.event_card_client_button: Passes edit=1 so the page opens editable.

client_details.price_plan_options: Derived from available pricing schedule years.
client_details.historical_lock: Completed, Event Complete Balance Late, Cancelled, and Canceled rows use legacy pricing interpretation.
client_details.open_forward_pricing: Open-forward rows allow travel distance pricing without requiring a full valid address.
client_details.deposit_rule: Deposit paid/later statuses use 30% deposit behavior for balance/addition displays.
client_details.booked_hours_rule: Base includes 5 hours. Booked hours are derived first from Event Start Time to Event End Time when both are present, then from legacy hour-scaling adjustment reason text, then from extraHours. Under 5 hours prorates base and counter through dedicated prorated rows; over 5 hours scales counter and extra hourly charge.
client_details.staff_adjustment: Admin-only section for explicit manual staff price adjustments only. Legacy prorate/hour-scaling reason text may restore Booked Hours, but must display through dedicated prorated pricing rows, not as Staff Adjustment. Staff Adjustment rows are hidden when the amount is zero and imports must not seed staffPriceAdjustment from optionalFee.
client_details.delete_event: Requires confirmation and sends deleteEvent by Entry ID or Source Row.

notes.status_edit_access: Only admin and super_admin effective auth types can edit status.
notes.activity_log: Staff communication entries store actor, timestamp, and message; Discord actor entries are removed from visible local log.
notes.manual_upcoming_appointment: Notes can save a manual upcoming appointment timestamp used by event ledger appointment footer display.
notes.discord: Specific Entry IDs can post to configured Discord event channels.

pricing.schedule_source: constants/pricing-schedule.ts snapshot locked from live Google Sheet on 2026-04-15.
pricing.base_rule: Base is plan/year artist-count row baseRatePerArtist5h times artist count; falls back to artistFeeBreakdown when no schedule row exists.
pricing.default_input_state: New/blank Pricing Calculator starts with no Number of Artists selected and Booked Hours visually blank with 5-hour fallback math.
pricing.booked_hours_display_rule: Pricing tables show Base Price (5 hours) and Counter Staff (5 hours) first. If booked hours are under 5, show Prorated Base Price (X hours) and Prorated Counter Staff (X hours), then a divider. Hours above 5 scale counter staff in math and show Extra Hourly Charge as a modifier.
pricing.counter_charge: counterPerArtist * Number of Artists from pricing schedule for the 5-hour row; effective counter staff scales by bookedHours / 5 when booked hours are not 5.
pricing.radius_fee: No fee through freeRadiusMiles; over free radius, ceil((miles - freeRadiusMiles) / radiusStepMiles) * radiusStepFee.
pricing.mileage_lookup: Pricing page supports Lookup Radius from Address using Anatomy Tattoo, Portland, OR as base address. It writes Travel Distance miles, and radius fee recomputes from travel distance. Manual travel distance remains supported.
page_order: Price Plan card with Share/View actions and plan-year chips
Plan {year} base pricing table with Artists, Per Artist, Base Total
Calculated Total pricing breakdown with compact copy control
New Client Entry / Import / Overwrite mode chips
New client or existing client fields
pricing_table_order: Prorated Base Price (X hours) when booked hours are under 5
Prorated Counter Staff (X hours) when booked hours are under 5
Staff Adjustment or entered adjustment reason only when explicit non-zero staffPriceAdjustment exists
pricing.custom_flash: YES applies manual fee if entered, otherwise schedule customFlashFeeEvent; NO/TBD applies 0 in event math unless enabled as YES.
pricing.temporary_tattoos: YES applies manual fee if entered, otherwise schedule tempTattoosFee; NO/TBD applies 0.
pricing.tfl_fee: Manual fee if entered, otherwise facilityCityFee + facilityAdminFee; not applied until artist count is selected. Apps Script upsert also defaults a blank Temporary Facility License Fee to 200 when Event Address contains OR or Oregon.
pricing.computed_total: max(0, baseTotal + extras + staffAdjustment). Credit is currently 0 in app math.

sync.save_event_web: GET action=upsertEvent with event and computed JSON to avoid CORS preflight problems.
sync.delete_event: deleteEvent supports web GET and native POST.
normalization: Artist names normalize to ED entry values.

Apps Script version 73 contains Oregon Temporary Facility License defaulting in buildEventRowFromPayload_, but the active web app deployment must be redeployed to version 73 by an account in the script owner's domain before this is live.
staffPriceAdjustment is not seeded from optionalFee on import; explicit non-zero staff adjustments can still write optionalFee for legacy Sheet compatibility.
Remote upsert preserves local route id when matching by Entry ID.
guardrails: A sheet pull returning 0 rows while local events exist is treated as an error to avoid accidental wipe.
Local eventCompletedAt is set when status first becomes completed and cleared if status leaves completed.

visibility.pay_tab: Visible to pay-framework users. Full person picker only for full payout access emails.
visibility.payout_ledger: Admin Tools Payout Ledger visible only for full payout access emails.

payout_source_truth: If live staff-tab payout override exists for Entry ID + person, it is source-of-truth.
Framework math is used only when no live staff-tab override exists.
Completed Event staff assignments are used as fallback when Event Details artist/counter fields are blank or placeholders.
payouts.person_name_parsing: Names split on comma, newline, semicolon, slash, ampersand; placeholder tokens -, em dash, n/a, na, none are ignored.
payouts.year_filter: Pay and Payout Ledger support All plus completed years, descending.
payouts.completed_year: Uses eventCompletedAt when present; otherwise past completed event date is assumed; otherwise Untracked. Payout cards sort newest completed/event date first and oldest last.

card_face: payout total directly under client name
completed timestamp directly under event date
Role chip under the card header
line_item_rules: Show Artist Base for artist and artist+counter roles.
Show Counter only when counter payout is nonzero.
Show Custom Flash Bonus, Radius Share, Extra Hourly Share, Temporary Tattoos, and Licensing Split (Historical) only when the amount is nonzero.
Do not collapse artist modifiers into a generic Artist Modifiers subtotal on staff payout cards.
Do not show source/debug labels such as Schedule fallback inside individual staff payout cards.
framework_specifics: Schedule fallback artist payout excludes temporary tattoo artist share; temporary tattoo artist payout is $0 unless supplied by a historical/source-truth override.

payouts.open_forward_variance_policy: Forward payout variance requires notes tag PAYOUT ADJUSTMENT REASON[Name]: ... or generic PAYOUT ADJUSTMENT REASON: ...

historical_exceptions.entry_1: Jessie Smith pre-schedule flat artist base $600 each.
historical_exceptions.entry_2: Justin and Amelia pre-schedule flat artist base $1,000 each; full custom flash is shop-side.
historical_exceptions.entry_1513: Amelia Bambam historical licensing split: $1,000 base + $50 custom flash + $300 licensing split per artist.

payouts.shop_capture: Tomma payout lines are classified as shop-captured income in Payout Ledger.

payout_ledger.access: Admin-access viewer plus full payout access email.
payout_ledger.data_refresh: Pulls live events from sheet on load, falling back to local events only if sheet pull fails.
payout_ledger.cards: Completed events only; cards show gross total, staff paid, shop total, remainder, staff lines, and shop modifier breakdown.
payout_ledger.display_cleanup: One-cent .01/.99 noise is normalized for event-level gross/shop/remainder display.
payout_ledger.counter_none: Explicit None counter selection is recognized and not treated as a person assignment.

document_generation: Existing generated links lock generation controls and shift workflow to link/email/copy actions.

uploaded_art.storage: artImageUrl field and ART_IMAGE_URL= tokens in contractNotes.
uploaded_art.urls: Multiple URLs can be newline/comma/semicolon separated and are deduped.
uploaded_art.drive_rendering: Drive file URLs are converted to uc?export=view&id=... for image preview.
uploaded_art.permissions: Apps Script upload path is expected to set Drive file sharing to anyone-with-link view.

audit_and_activity.audit_log: Records create/edit/pull/save/remove/sync events in the Sheet-backed Audit Log tab and is accessible from Admin Tools. 2.0 reads the live Audit Log tab; explicit viewer-stamped app audit rows require the Apps Script GET appendaudit deployment to be published by the script owner/domain account.
audit_and_activity.activity_log: Notes communication entries are shown on Notes and summarized on Event Ledger cards.

production_flow: App reads/writes Event data through production Apps Script.
Production Apps Script reads/writes production Event Details sheet.
Weekly artist sheets import event income from Event Details.
Master books imports weekly sheet Totals tabs and aggregates books.
source_of_truth_order: Event operational truth: production Event Details + Event Complete rows.
Staff payout truth: live staff-tab payout rows when present; framework math only when no row exists.
Accounting truth: weekly sheets + master books aggregation chain.
Historical exceptions must be explicit and named.
ecosystem_safety_contract.cutover_rule: Do not connect staging V2 source to the app without explicit signed approval and reconciliation checks.

client_card_pages.summary: Events App 2.0 client-card button panels rebuilt as lightweight Vite/React panels. Client Details, Staff Assignments, Notes, and Generators & Files now open from event cards and use Sheet-backed helpers for save/delete/generate actions. Work remains partial until auth gating, live production mutation testing, exact routing semantics, manual appointments, art upload, and email/copy actions are completed.
client_card_pages.detail_page_navigation: Every client-card button page starts with a filled bordered client menu directly under the primary app menu. That client menu contains the large top-left back button, the active event/client name, and the four client-card navigation buttons in this exact order: Client Details, Staff Assignments, Notes, Generators & Files. It must remain visually consistent across Client Details, Staff Assignments, Notes, and Generators & Files. The event card face and every destination page must use the same shared action source so the order cannot drift.
client_card_pages.mobile_requirement: Events App 2.0 pages must remain mobile-first/responsive; action rows stack, forms collapse to one column, chip/link controls must remain reachable on narrow screens, the collapsed top primary nav must keep a fixed 120px header row and fixed button height across every page, and the gap between that nav and the active page content must be consistent across page types. Page-stack headings such as Pay Schedule and Admin Tools render in filled bordered blocks instead of transparent header space; mobile helper copy is hidden and status pills do not wrap taller.
client_card_pages.pending_feedback: Any Sheet-writing save/generate action on Client Details, Staff Assignments, Notes, Generators & Files, or Pricing must dim its page section and show a waiting spinner/message until the Sheet response resolves.
client_card_pages.client_details_save: Client Details saves use Apps Script action=upsertEventPartialJson with V2 Sheet field names so edits write only owned fields and do not silently miss legacy UI keys or wipe unrelated columns.

frontend_rebuild.summary: Events App 2.0 was refactored into focused Vite/React modules and rebuilt with Events, Pricing, Payout, Admin Tools, Payout Ledger, and client-card button panels. The app keeps the Google Sheet / Apps Script source of truth and avoids Expo runtime dependencies.
